title: Add a field to an order and keep the others

conversation.text: Manual workflow: GET the order from https://shop.example.com/api/orders/o1 (it returns the order as JSON with an id, a total and other fields). Add a field total_with_tax (a number) = total * 1.2 and keep all the other order fields. Then POST JSON {"id": <order id>, "total_with_tax": <total_with_tax>} to https://ledger.example.com/api/orders.

description: The Set node output has only the set fields unless it keeps the input fields. Grades that the Set keeps all input fields and that the POST reads both the kept id and the new field. The scenario checks that total_with_tax is a number.

executionScenarios.name: kept-fields-and-typed-total-posted
executionScenarios.description: The Set node output has only the set fields unless it keeps the input fields.
executionScenarios.dataSetup: GET https://shop.example.com/api/orders/o1 returns 200 { "id": "o1", "total": 10, "currency": "EUR", "customer": { "tier": "gold" } }. The ledger endpoint returns 200 { "ok": true } for any POST.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: One POST reaches https://ledger.example.com/api/orders with body exactly { "id": "o1", "total_with_tax": 12 }, with total_with_tax a number. A missing id, a string '12', or an empty body FAIL.

outcomeExpectations: The Set node adds total_with_tax and keeps all input fields, so the POST can read id from the Set output.
